decisions.reason: As a sensor module close to the core platform and given stronger 2024 presentation on its own page, it likely meets or is near aspiration levels and is cheap to retain within the modular range.
This industrial input module is tightly aligned with the firm's established automation offer and continued dedicated promotion suggests satisfactory performance relative to aspirations.

Although it received less visible promotion than some peers, it fits the existing control architecture well and in a growing, slack-rich firm the likely response is to keep testing demand rather than withdraw quickly.

The module is new and somewhat less central than core sensing products, but boundedly rational management in an expanding firm would usually tolerate short-run uncertainty for a complementary platform item.

Despite being a newer service with ongoing support needs, it supports the stated strategic expansion in charging and energy management, so management is likely to keep it while learning about market uptake.
